about.title: About TinyJPG Compressor
about.intro: TinyJPG Compressor is a desktop batch image compression tool based on TinyPNG API, built with Python + PyQt5. Designed for designers, operators, and developers who need to process images in bulk.
features_list: Fully offline client — images are only sent to TinyPNG API for processing
Multi-threaded concurrent compression for maximum efficiency
Flexible compression options: scale, crop, fit modes
Visual watermark editor with real-time preview
about.tech_stack: Tech Stack: Python 3.12 + PyQt5 + Pillow + TinyPNG API
about.license: This is a personal open-source project, free to use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: TinyJPG Compressor respects and protects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
1. Information Collection: Your TinyPNG API Key is stored locally in a config file and is never uploaded to any third-party server.
2. Image Processing: All images are processed via the official TinyPNG API. We do not store or forward your images.
3. Logging: Compression history is stored locally and never automatically uploaded.
4. Third-Party Services: This tool uses the TinyPNG API. Please refer to TinyPNG's privacy policy for their data handling.
5. Contact: For privacy-related questions, please reach out through our contact channels.
